definition: 100 × (imports_t / imports_(t-1) − 1).
source: Recalculated from compiled imports_musd levels.
caveats: Missing when current/prior imports are unavailable; September 2026 is missing.

definition: 100 × (remit_t / remit_(t-1) − 1).

definition: 100 × (reserves_t / reserves_(t-1) − 1).
source: Recalculated from compiled sbp_reserves_musd levels.
caveats: Missing where current/prior reserve levels are missing; extremes retained without clipping.

definition: Exports minus imports.
source: Recalculated as exports_musd − imports_musd.
caveats: Missing if either component is missing; definition/source valuation basis not verified.

definition: 1 if next month's fx_avg is strictly higher than this month's; otherwise 0.
source: Recalculated from adjacent fx_avg values; primary target.
caveats: Last row missing by design; equal FX averages are classified as 0.

definition: 1 if next month's FX average rises by strictly more than 0.25%; otherwise 0.
source: Recalculated from adjacent fx_avg values; robustness target.
caveats: Strict >0.25% threshold; last row missing by design.

definition: 1 if current month's FX average exceeds previous month's; otherwise 0.
source: Recalculated from fx_avg.
caveats: First row missing because there is no June 2005 FX value in the file.
